title: Solve Intelligence Partners with Juristat to Bring Enhanced Examiner Analytics to AI Patent Prosecution
summary: Juristat customers can now access examiner and prosecution analytics directly inside Solve Intelligence for more informed office action strategy.
body_markdown:
Juristat and Solve Intelligence have partnered to bring Juristat's examiner analytics and USPTO prosecution history directly into Solve Intelligence. Patent professionals can now pair Solve Intelligence's prosecution workflows with over two decades of examiner and art unit data.


## Key insights


- Juristat customers can now access Juristat's prosecution intelligence directly within Solve Intelligence.
- Patent professionals can combine Solve Intelligence's AI-powered prosecution workflows with Juristat's examiner analytics, art unit data, and more than two decades of USPTO prosecution history.
- Juristat and Solve Intelligence customers activate the integration by enabling a single MCP connector.
‍


[Patent prosecution](https://www.solveintelligence.com/product/prosecution) is not one-size-fits-all. Two nearly identical applications can follow very different paths depending on the examiner assigned, their examination history, and the art unit involved.


Understanding that context matters. Examiner statistics can help patent professionals make more informed decisions about how to approach prosecution, from anticipating likely outcomes and identifying effective response strategies to advising clients on cost, timing, and risk.


That is why **Solve Intelligence and Juristat are partnering together.**


## Who Solve Intelligence and Juristat are


[Solve Intelligence](https://www.solveintelligence.com/) is the[category leader in purpose-built AI for patents](https://www.solveintelligence.com/blog/post/solve-intelligence-ranked-1-ip-platform-by-the-worlds-leading-law-firms) , trusted by more than 700 IP firms and corporations globally to support[patent drafting](https://www.solveintelligence.com/product/drafting) , prosecution, prior art analysis, and other complex patent workflows.


[Juristat](https://juristat.com/) is the strongest, most trusted USPTO data source in the market: more than 10 million pending, abandoned, and granted applications and over 20,000 examiners, going back to 2002. Juristat cleans and structures that record into prosecution intelligence, so patent professionals see not just how an examiner behaves, but what has actually worked, by response type, rejection, and art unit.


## Juristat's prosecution data, now inside Solve Intelligence


We’re pleased to share that Juristat users can now access the Juristat Data Layer within Solve Intelligence’s specialized AI for IP platform.


Together, Juristat and Solve Intelligence are bringing best-in-class patent AI and best-in-class prosecution intelligence closer together.


> *“Anyone can pull a basic allowance rate. The sophisticated move is to look at what has actually worked for a given examiner, on a given rejection, in a given art unit. That is the prosecution record we are bringing into Solve.”*


*Lauren Bonner, CEO, Juristat*


> *“We’re thrilled that Solve Intelligence customers can now access Juristat within the Solve platform, centralizing where patent work gets done. Juristat’s examiner analytics data provide Solve’s AI agents with some of the deepest and most valuable proprietary IP data, enabling practitioners using Solve to make the highest-quality strategic decisions across the patent process. The Solve and Juristat teams work extremely well together, and we know this partnership will bring patent workflows in Solve to a new level.”*


*Chris Parsonson, CEO, Solve Intelligence*


## How Juristat brings 20+ years of USPTO prosecution history to its examiner intelligence engine


Raw USPTO records contain inconsistencies in examiner and applicant names, fragmented case histories, and individual records that must be connected before meaningful trends emerge. Juristat has spent more than a decade doing exactly that work.


Juristat maintains the complete public USPTO prosecution record from 2002 to today, continuously cleaning, resolving, and structuring that data to turn millions of individual records into actionable prosecution intelligence.


That depth matters. Patent professionals can evaluate examiner allowance rates, office action patterns, interview outcomes, appeals, RCEs, and other prosecution behavior across an examiner’s career… not simply a narrow snapshot of recent activity.


## Giving patent professionals more context for every prosecution decision


Prosecution statistics provide something that even the most sophisticated analysis of an individual office action cannot: context.


When preparing[office action responses](https://www.solveintelligence.com/blog/post/prepare-responses-to-uspto-office-actions) , patent professionals’ strategy may change depending on the answers to critical questions, including:


- How frequently does an examiner allow applications?
- How many rounds of prosecution are typical?
- How successful are particular response strategies?
- How does this examiner compare with others in the same art unit?


These insights can materially shape prosecution strategy, thereby equipping patent professionals with better information with which to craft office action responses.


## What Solve Intelligence and Juristat each bring to prosecution work


Both Solve Intelligence and Juristat were built around the unique complexity of patent practice.


Solve Intelligence brings purpose-built AI designed to help patent professionals execute highly technical patent work faster and with greater precision. Juristat brings years of specialized prosecution data and analytics that help practitioners understand what is happening across the USPTO and what it means for a particular application.


By partnering, Solve Intelligence and Juristat are combining the intelligence behind *what to do* with deeper context around *how an examiner is likely to respond* .


We’re excited to build the next generation of data-driven patent prosecution together.


New to either platform?[Book a demo](https://www.solveintelligence.com/book-demo) to see the integration in action.


## Frequently asked questions


#### What does this partnership mean for customers who have access to both Solve Intelligence and Juristat?


Juristat subscribers can now connect their accounts to Solve Intelligence, enable Juristat as a source, and bring examiner-level statistics directly into AI-assisted patent prosecution workflows.


#### What about customers who have access to one platform, but not the other?


If you are a Solve Intelligence customer and would like access to Juristat, please emailsolvepartnership@juristat.com .


If you are a Juristat customer and would like access to Solve Intelligence, please emailpartnerships@solveintelligence.com and cc Angel Wang atangel@solveintelligence.com .


#### How will Juristat’s patent intelligence be available and displayed within Solve’s platform?


Solve Intelligence already provides a chat-based environment in which practitioners can attach matter documents, ask targeted questions, and receive sourced answers. Enabling Juristat adds examiner analytics as another specialized source available within that same workflow.
